title: MiniMax H3: Text to Image
summary: Generate a single still image from a text prompt with MiniMax H3, an omni-modal video model used here for its first-frame decode. No file inputs required: the graph samples an empty latent and decodes it through the H3 video VAE. Best suited to a single subject with a defined light source and a simple or blurred background.
